jobs.occupation: Join our Backend Team in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
We’re looking for experienced Backend Developers in Gothenburg who combine strong technical skills with ownership, curiosity and a genuine drive to move things forward.
What you’ll be working with
You’ll join a development team at one of our clients, building and operating modern backend services and cloud-based platforms for connected products and digital services.
The exact technology stack will vary by assignment. It may include Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go, together with AWS and/or Azure. Some teams focus on customer-facing backend services, while others develop cloud platforms, integrations and developer tools.
You’ll work in a collaborative, DevOps-oriented environment and contribute throughout the service lifecycle, from design and development to deployment, monitoring, operations and continuous improvement.
Your work may include
Developing and maintaining backend services using Java, C#/.NET, Python and/or Go
Designing and building cloud-native solutions on AWS or Azure
Building REST APIs, microservices and integrations
Working with event-driven systems and distributed architectures
Using cloud services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and SQS
Working with containers and Kubernetes, depending on the team
Improving CI/CD, automation, monitoring, logging and service reliability
Contributing to code reviews, technical discussions and architecture decisions

Skills & qualifications
We’re looking for someone with:
At least 5 years of professional backend development experience
Strong experience in at least one of the following: Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure
Experience building and operating APIs, services or distributed systems
A good understanding of software quality, reliability and maintainability
Fluent written and spoken English
A BSc or MSc in Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good to have
AWS serverless experience, such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS
Experience with Azure services
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications
CI/CD and DevOps practices
Event-driven architecture or tools such as Kafka
Experience in connected services, IoT, automotive or telecom
Fluent written and spoken Swedish

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

jobs.occupation: Line Manager for Dynamic Control Design
jobs.description:
The opportunity
The Dynamic Control Design team in Ludvika, Sweden is seeking a manager to take on the role as leader to support and develop the individuals, the group, and the team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the team that is responsible for the overall performance of HVDC transmission links, focusing on the dynamic control design.
As the Line Manager for Dynamic Control Design, you will have personnel responsibility for a team of approximately 15-20 professionals reporting to you. You will be tasked with ensuring that the team is adequately resourced, developed, and equipped to meet business needs, as well as ensuring that the company's culture and values are reflected in all employee practices and policies. Your primary objective will be to motivate and engage your team and to support them to achieve their full potential, while ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations.
“We are searching for you who is interested in people and prepared to support and inspire your coworkers. We believe everything can be improved and it is vital that you have a positive mindset to a learning organization that is continuously improving its knowledge, methods, and skills." - Hiring Manager Magnus Öhrström.
How you'll make an impact
Building and developing the team and the individuals in it by managing recruitment of new members, employee training and development initiatives, as well as providing strategic direction, leadership, and coordination of the function.
Contribute to the HVDC System Performance Management team and collaborate with other managers in the organization related to system studies.
Planning for project staffing and adjusting it according to business needs, as well as planning for both short-term and more strategic long-term changes in the team structure.
Develop the processes and tools within your team.
Preparing annual budget and manage within budget and resource constraints.
Take part of the entire design process from technology development, marketing support & tender work to final design and verification in HVDC projects.

Your background 
Solid experience in HVDC technology and system performance studies, with a minimum of five years of leadership experience in a people management role or a comparable leadership position, such as Project Manager.
Strong communication, social, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with employees and management. 
Fluency in English is required; knowledge of Swedish is a plus.
A true team player and ability to work in an analytical and structured manner.
You take responsibility for your work, your coworkers and deliver quality results on time.

jobs.occupation: Senior Type Testing Engineer - HVDC Control & Protection
jobs.description:
In this role you will be part of a new expanding department that will focus on type testing and type approvals within HVDC for Electrical Environment. We are part of Control & Protection for hardware design. We are designing the automation system layout with placement of circuit boards and cable channeling and more, at our sites. Our cubicles have control cabinet layout, consisting of hundreds of circuit boards for measurements, control and calculations. Our system also includes user interfaces such as HMI (Human Machine Interface), diagnostic tools and IT infrastructure and IT security. For this we utilize our in-house developed real-time platform MACH to meet the power industry’s standards.
In this position you will have a bigger scope than the actual testing. You will be part of requirements, standards, test setups, evaluating test results and be included in the actual testing. We offer an exciting and stimulating work environment in a growing business where you will be part of delivering technologies in world class. Now we need to strengthen our team with senior engineers with focus on type testing. We value your experience and your potential to develop and would like to get to know you.

Knowledge within EMC, climatic tests, mechanical tests and safety.

Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!
Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.
In our companies, we develop data‑driven software solutions that solve real operational challenges for our customers. Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Our customers are mainly within transportation, logistics, and field services – but we also help companies in other industries as well.
With our newly developed next-generation platform, Ecoroute, we are redefining how companies plan, optimize and execute their daily transportation operations. From route optimization to real-time execution, we help our customers reduce costs, improve service levels, and make better decisions every day.
About the role As an Account Executive you will play a key role in driving the growth across Sweden and other Nordic and Northern European countries. You will own the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal, working closely with decision-makers in transport, logistics, and field service industries. You will collaborate with product and customer teams to ensure a strong fit and high-quality customer experience.
You will be part of an ambitious, high-performance environment where we push each other to improve and win together. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, located at one of our sister companies to ensure close collaboration to Geopt’s Chief Commercial Officer, who is based in Denmark.
Your responsibilities:

Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

Lead customer meetings, both digital and in person, an demonstrate the value of our offerings – with particular focus on Ecoroute.

Drive negotiations and close new deals.

Work closely with your colleagues within the Customer Success and Product teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value for the customer.

Provide market feedback and insights that shape product and commercial development.

Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is proactive, ambitious, and results-driven – with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move deals forward. You will thrive in this role if you have experience with B2B sales, preferably within SaaS. We also believe that you have:

A strong set of communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly.

A comprehensive and solution‑oriented mindset.

Natural authority and execution power, combined with a positive and pragmatic attitude.

Hunter mentality.

"Grit" – you don't give up, even when the work presents challenges.

The ability to communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.

A valid driver’s license.

Experience from the transportation or logistics industry is considered a plus, as well as the ability to “speak tech,” such as understanding APIs, integrations, and technical concepts.
Interested? Contact us! Does this sound like a role and environment that would suit you? Apply, connect with us, or share this opportunity with someone you think might be a great fit.
If you have questions, reach out to Linnea Olsson, People Business Partner at Movement Software.
We are a part of Movement Software
Ecoroute is part of Movement Software (formerly Progrits), a Northern European software group consisting of around twenty entrepreneur-led companies across three business areas: Vehicle digital solutions, Transport & logistics, and the public mobility. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.
Being part of Movement Software provides us with greater opportunities for growth and development, both as a company and as individuals, while also offering the stability and resources of a larger group.

Since 1969, Flygprestanda AB has been at the forefront of aviation performance technology. With decades of industry expertise, we develop innovative Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that help airlines and aircraft operators worldwide perform safe and efficient takeoff and landing performance calculations.
Based in central Malmö, we combine deep aviation knowledge with cutting-edge technology to deliver solutions that make a real difference in aviation safety.
Now, we're looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Representative to join our close-knit Sales & Marketing team and help us reach new heights.

The opportunity
Are you a natural communicator who enjoys building relationships, discovering new business opportunities, and turning conversations into successful partnerships? Are you curious about technology and excited by the prospect of working with customers around the world?
As our Sales Representative, you'll play a key role in driving growth and expanding our international customer base. You'll connect with prospective and existing customers, present innovative software solutions, and help airlines and aircraft operators discover how our technology can support their operations.
This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll combine proactive sales, customer engagement, online product demonstrations, and account management. You'll also work closely with colleagues across engineering, software development, finance, and marketing, gaining valuable insight into both our products and the aviation industry.
What you'll be doing
Create new business opportunities by following up on inbound leads and reaching out to prospective and existing customers through calls and emails.
Build lasting customer relationships by understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities, and providing a professional, responsive experience.
Drive sales forward by preparing commercial proposals, negotiating offers, and closing deals to achieve sales targets.
Showcase our technology by delivering engaging online demonstrations that bring the benefits of our software to life.
Support our customers and sales pipeline through account administration and accurate maintenance of customer and prospect databases.
Discover new opportunities through market research, industry insights, and competitor analysis.
Collaborate across teams to ensure a smooth customer journey, from the first conversation to a successful partnership.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and motivated by results. You enjoy taking initiative, communicating with people, and finding solutions that create value for customers.
You don't shy away from picking up the phone, following up on opportunities, or starting conversations with new prospects. You're equally comfortable working independently and contributing to a collaborative team environment.
You may already have experience in sales, or you may be ready to take the next step in your commercial career. An interest in technology, digital solutions, or aviation would be a great advantage.
You'll bring:
Previous sales experience and a genuine interest in developing new business.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with international customers.
Strong listening and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
Experience using CRM systems and MS Office or LibreOffice.
The ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and organize your working day.
A structured, thorough, and solution-oriented approach to your work.
A positive team spirit and a professional attitude.

Experience in the aviation industry and a degree in business or a related field are advantageous, but not essential. Some international travel may be required.
Why join Flygprestanda?
International reach: Work with airlines and aircraft operators across the world.
Meaningful technology: Represent software solutions that contribute to safe aviation operations.
A varied role: Combine sales, customer relationships, technology, and market development.
A collaborative environment: Work closely with knowledgeable colleagues across multiple disciplines.
A strong industry foundation: Join a company with a long history of aviation expertise and a forward-looking approach to technology.

Practical information
Location: Central Malmö, Sweden
Salary: Starting from SEK 34,000 per month

Want to take over the technical leadership of a Nordic market leader? Skip the corporate bureaucracy, drive next-generation structural engineering, and build the new product portfolio for the infrastructure that will support the global transition to 6G. Today Cue Dee are a leading supplier to leading mobile operators, TowerCo (Tower Company) and system integrators in Europe.

This recruitment is conducted in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. However, you will be employed directly by CUE DEE AB.

Cue Dee is the Nordic market leader in telecom infrastructure solutions, with a strong market presence and office in Stockholm, Umeå and Gdansk. Backed by the stable Lagercrantz Group, we combine 45+ years of heritage with global industrial manufacturing-and we are gearing up to celebrate our 50th anniversary in 2028. We develop and sell specific steel and aluminum structures used at telecom sites and rooftops worldwide.

We design, develop, and supply optimized steel and aluminum structures, both standard and customized, for telecom sites and rooftop applications worldwide.

 We are looking for our new Head of Product Development. This is a structured succession role: you will start hands-on alongside our current R&D Manager. Within 6-12 months, you will fully take over the function, join the Management Team, report directly to the CEO, and take on formal responsibility for your own team of senior and junior designers.

The Mission: Technical Leadership, develop new products for the infrastructure for 6G Innovation
 This role is heavily weighted toward structural technology and design, giving you the mandate to shape our technical roadmap as the world prepares for the implementation of 6G.

 
Design for Manufacture: Drive mechanical and structural product development from raw requirements to market-ready products. You ensure that what you and the team design can be manufactured efficiently.
Commercial Acumen: You apply your technical expertise to lay the strategic and technical groundwork for new deals, providing our sales team with the perfect product foundation to close agreements. You need to be business driven and open to meeting and understanding customers to industrialize the customer needs into our new product portfolio.
Presence & Travel: Your base is in Kista, but you will visit our other office outside Umeå and our team in Poland. Travel is primarily within Sweden and Europe (approx. 15-20 days per year) to meet customers, production teams, and suppliers.

 

 Who You Are
 You are a sharp mechanical engineer with leadership experience who wants to make a real business impact. Telecom industry experience is welcomed but not required for this role. We place great value on strong engineering expertise in areas such as structural design, mechanics, and materials engineering. At the same time, we believe that experience from other industries can bring fresh perspectives, innovative ideas, and valuable expertise that strengthen our team and drive continuous improvement.
Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and coaching a smaller group of engineers or product developers.
The Foundation: A relevant technical degree or engineering background, combined with a solid track record in mechanical product development and manufacturing.
The Tech & Material Edge: Knowledge in structural design and in materials, manufacturing methods, materials and particularly steel and aluminum.
Building/Structural Mindset: Since our products are installed in demanding environments (often on existing building rooftops), a solid understanding of structural engineering, load-bearing structures, or building technology is an advantage.
The Mindset: Accountable, pragmatic, and business-minded. You avoid unnecessary overengineering and focus on safety, compliance, cost-efficiency, and manufacturability.
Language: Fluent English. Swedish is a strong asset.

Why Cue Dee?
 You get the financial backing of a powerhouse group, but the speed, impact, and entrepreneurial culture of an agile, market-leading 30-person company.

Short decision-making paths, real product ownership, and direct interaction with the CEO enable you to take ideas from concept to finished product with speed and impact.

Job Description:
We are looking for a Junior Technical Project Engineer who wants to start a career in engineering project delivery and work alongside experienced engineers in a global and technology-driven environment. As a Mobile Engineering Manager at Rebtel, you will lead the engineers behind our iOS and Android apps, combining hands-on native mobile development with coaching and team leadership. You will also champion the effective use of AI-assisted development to improve productivity while maintaining strong engineering standards and ownership.
This is not a management-only role. You will write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help solve difficult technical problems while taking responsibility for the team's development and delivery. Your impact will come from both what you build and how you help others grow.
Areas of ownership:

Coach and develop engineers through regular one-to-ones, clear feedback and career development. Help people strengthen their technical judgment, grow their skills and take greater ownership.

Stay hands-on with native development. Write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help investigate challenging bugs and performance issues using native platform tools.

Help the team use AI effectively. Lead by example with AI-assisted development tools, share practical approaches and coach engineers to critically evaluate outputs while maintaining code quality, security and ownership.

Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Product, Design and Backend Engineering to turn customer needs into clear priorities, deliver valuable features and balance short-term goals with long-term app quality.

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. English is our working language, but you'll hear many different languages in our Stockholm office.

A strong track record as a native mobile engineer, with production iOS or Android apps you have personally designed, built and shipped.

Deep hands-on expertise in native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) or Android development (Kotlin/Java). Experience leading and developing engineers, including coaching, giving feedback, supporting career growth and managing performance. You know how to stay technically involved without taking over.

Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools. You understand where they add value, where they fall short and how to validate their output.

Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing quality, delivery and long-term maintainability.

🌳 Erfaren klättrande arborist sökes – Stockholm
See English below.
Svenska Trädmästarna AB söker en erfaren, skicklig och säker klättrande arborist till vårt team i Stockholm.
Vi söker dig som har minst 3–5 års yrkeserfarenhet, gärna längre, och är riktigt duktig på att klättra, beskära, rigga och sektionsfälla träd. Vi lägger stor vikt bra klättring, och att komma långt ut på grenar för beskärning. 
 
 Trädmästarna är ett av landets ledande trädvårdsföretag, med över 30 år i branschen. Vi är specialiserade på skyddsvärda träd och träd i kulturhistoriska miljöer.
Att du delar vår kärlek till träd ser vi som en självklar förutsättning. Ett intresse för naturvård, ekologi och biologisk mångfald är också mycket värdefullt. Högskoleutbildning, särskilt inom biologi eller ekologi är starkt meriterande, även om klättringen i just denna position är det som är i fokus. 
 
 Vi söker dig som också är bra med kunder och kollegor och som kan och vill ta ansvar för egna projekt. Här finns stora möjligheter att utvecklas och få mer ansvar. Vi vill växa med bra personer och det är så vi tror att vi kommer att forma arboristbranschen i Sverige även de kommande 30 åren.
Krav: B-körkort, motorsågskörkort AB eller motsvarande, samt relevant arboristutbildning eller motsvarande yrkeskompetens.
Meriterande: ETW, ISA eller VETcert, BE-körkort, motorsåg C–F och I, utbildning för skylift och motorsåg i skylift samt Arbete på väg 1.1–1.3.
Vi hjälper gärna rätt person med vidareutbildning och certifieringar.
Vi erbjuder mycket varierande arbeten, från beskärning hos privatpersoner till vård av gamla veteranträd i kungliga parker. Vi arbetar främst i Stockholm, men även i övriga Sverige och ibland på svenska ambassader utomlands.
Konkurrenskraftig lön för rätt person.
Läs gärna mer om oss och se vad våra kunder säger på www.tradmastarna.se.
Skicka CV, en kort presentation och gärna bilder eller filmer från ditt arbete till oskar.schonning@tradmastarna.se Skicka gärna en kopia till vår drift- och produktionsansvarige david.rimmel@tradmastarna.se

🌳 Experienced Climbing Arborist Wanted – Stockholm, Sweden
Svenska Trädmästarna AB is looking for an experienced, skilled and safety-conscious climbing arborist to join our team in Stockholm.
We are looking for someone with at least 3–5 years of professional experience, preferably more, who is highly skilled in climbing, pruning, rigging and sectional dismantling. We place great importance on good climbing skills and the ability to reach far out along branches for pruning.
Trädmästarna is one of Sweden's leading tree care companies, with over 30 years of experience in the industry. We specialize in protected and valuable trees, as well as trees in historically and culturally important environments.
We take it for granted that you share our love of trees. An interest in nature conservation, ecology and biodiversity is also highly valued. A university education, particularly in biology or ecology, is a strong advantage, although climbing is the main focus of this particular position.
We are particularly interested in someone who works well with clients and colleagues and who is able and willing to take responsibility for their own projects. There are great opportunities to develop professionally and take on more responsibility.
We want to grow with good people, and that is how we believe we will continue to shape the arborist industry in Sweden over the next 30 years.
Requirements: Category B driving licence, chainsaw qualifications equivalent to Swedish levels A and B, and relevant arborist training or equivalent professional experience.
Desirable qualifications: ETW, ISA or VETcert certification, BE driving licence, chainsaw qualifications C–F and I, training in operating mobile elevating work platforms (MEWPs) and using chainsaws from a platform, and Arbete på väg (Working on Roads) qualifications 1.1–1.3.
We are happy to support the right person with further training and professional certifications.
We offer highly varied work, ranging from pruning trees in private gardens to caring for ancient veteran trees in royal parks. We work mainly in Stockholm, but also throughout Sweden and occasionally at Swedish embassies abroad.
Competitive salary for the right person.
Please visit www.tradmastarna.se to learn more about us and see what our clients say about our work.
Send your CV, a short introduction and preferably photos or videos of your work to oskar@tradmastarna.se. Please also send a copy to our Operations and Production Manager, david.rimmel@tradmastarna.se.

Shape the future of enterprise knowledge with Multiply. Design semantic information architectures, develop ontologies and knowledge graphs, and build AI-ready data foundations while contributing to VisFlow Runa, our Knowledge Platform.

About Multiply
Multiply Teknik & IT AB is a Sweden based End-to-End solution Provider specializing in Enterprise Architecture, Data & Information Management, AI, Software Engineering, and Digital Transformation.

We combine specialist knowledge solutions with the development and deployment of our own technology solutions, giving our colleagues the opportunity to work on challenging enterprise initiatives while contributing to innovative products.

We are now looking for experienced Information & Knowledge Architects to join our growing team in Stockholm.

About VisFlow & Runa
VisFlow (visflow.io) is our technology ecosystem focused on connecting enterprise information, processes, knowledge, and operational intelligence.

An important part of VisFlow is Runa, our Knowledge Platform, which focuses on ontology management, knowledge graphs, semantic modelling, metadata, and enterprise information architecture.

Our vision is to be the preferred partner for Flow thinking and End-to-End Operations aspects of any business, semantically enriched knowledge foundations that bring together business concepts, information structures, relationships, and context to support data governance, interoperability, and AI-driven applications.

As part of Multiply, you will have opportunities to contribute to the evolution of Runa and explore how its capabilities can address real enterprise challenges.

The Role
You will work at the intersection of Information Architecture, Data Management, Semantic Technologies, and AI, supporting organizations in developing trusted, connected, and AI-ready information foundations.

Your work will include customer-facing enterprise transformation and architecture assignments, using the technologies, platforms, and approaches best suited to each organization's needs.

Alongside these engagements, you will have opportunities to contribute to VisFlow Runa, bringing practical enterprise experience into our product development and exploring its application where relevant.

Your responsibilities include:

Design and govern enterprise information models, conceptual models, ontologies, and knowledge graphs.

Establish semantic and context layers connecting business concepts, metadata, and technical data structures.

Support enterprise transformation towards AI-ready Data & Information Management.

Develop practical Data Governance frameworks, standards, and information management principles.

Improve Data Quality, Metadata Management, Master Data Management (MDM), and information interoperability.

Apply semantic technologies and knowledge representation approaches to complex enterprise challenges.

Collaborate with business, IT, architecture, and AI teams to implement sustainable information management capabilities.

Contribute expertise and practical insights to the development and application of VisFlow Runa's ontology management and Knowledge Graph capabilities.

Your Profile
We are looking for experienced, pragmatic, and hands-on professionals who combine architectural expertise with an understanding of business needs and enterprise transformation.

Ideally, you have:

7+ years of experience in Information Management, Data Management, Information Architecture, or related fields.

Experience supporting enterprise-wide Data & Information Management initiatives and transformations.

Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, MDM, and Metadata Management.

Experience with enterprise information modelling, ontologies, semantic architecture, or knowledge graphs.

Knowledge of semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL.

Understanding of AI-ready data foundations, knowledge representation, and contextualized information.

Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree.

Fluent professional English. Swedish is advantageous.

Experience with Knowledge Graph platforms such as GraphDB, Stardog, Neo4j, or Apache Jena, as well as GraphRAG and knowledge-driven AI applications, is considered advantageous.

Why Join Multiply?
Work on challenging enterprise Data & Information Management and AI-readiness initiatives.

Combine customer-facing consulting with opportunities to contribute to our own technology development.

Help shape VisFlow Runa's evolution in ontology management, semantic architecture, and knowledge graphs.

Work with different technologies and architectural approaches across complex enterprise environments.

Collaborate with specialists in Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Software Development, and AI.

Influence how organizations connect, understand, govern, and utilize enterprise knowledge.

Location & Employment
Location: On-Site, Stockholm Area/Malmö Area

Employment: Permanent, full-time position with Multiply Teknik & IT AB.

Working arrangement: On-Site, Stockholm Area/Malmö Area

Start: As soon as possible. Candidates available immediately or within 1–2 months are particularly welcome.

Join Us
Are you passionate about Information Architecture, Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs, and building AI-ready enterprise information foundations?

Join Multiply, contribute to meaningful enterprise transformation initiatives, and help us advance the future of knowledge management through VisFlow Runa.

www.multiply.tech | www.visflow.io

TL;DR – We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help scale the future of AI-powered software creation. You'll build and lead the FDE team and partner with our most ambitious customers to turn ideas into real products. This is still a hands-on role: you'll design, write, and ship production code alongside your team, while partnering with our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. It's a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems that no one has solved before.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.
We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
About the role
Most engineering leadership roles move you away from the code. This one keeps you close to the craft and the customer.
You'll build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who partner with our customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving hard technical problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn't just to make individual deployments succeed. It's to spot what should become part of the Lovable platform and act on it.
As one of a small group of FDE leaders, you'll set the technical bar for the function and help define how it scales, from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it works with customers and our core product teams.
If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself, this is that role.
What we're looking for
12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering

Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams
A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown
Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development
Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end
Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users
Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior stakeholders
Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and velocity

Bonus if you've:
Scaled a team or technical function from zero

Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production
Led zero-to-one product development
Worked in a founding or early startup environment
Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AI

What you'll do
Build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers

Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems
Design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team
Own and guide projects end-to-end, from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration
Set the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and hands-on engineering
Translate insights from customer deployments into foundational platform improvements
Partner with other FDE leads to shape the function's engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks as it scales globally
Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

Our Tech Stack

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Parts and Services - Central & Northern Europe / Normet

Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!
About The Role
As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join our DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.
Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.
In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.

Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.

Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.

Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.

Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.

Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are
We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.
You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.
AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.
We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.

Strong .NET/C# development skills.

Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.

Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.

Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.
Why join Myntro?
At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.

What does it take to keep a growing renewable energy business connected, secure and ready for the future? At OX2, cloud infrastructure supports everything from daily operations and business-critical systems to data platforms and AI. We are now looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Lead to take ownership of our infrastructure landscape, shape its technical direction and ensure that our platforms support the business as it continues to develop.
YOU WILL
OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As OX2 expands its role as an independent power producer, the demand for its digital infrastructure continues to grow. Secure, reliable and well-managed cloud platforms are essential to supporting operations across different markets, as well as the company's ambitions within data and AI.
As Cloud & Infrastructure Lead, you will take overall responsibility for OX2's cloud and infrastructure environment, spanning Azure, AWS and the services connecting them. You will set technical expectations, evaluate proposed solutions and follow up on delivery. You will also work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure that infrastructure decisions support both operational needs and future digital initiatives.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Own and develop OX2's cloud infrastructure, including Azure and AWS architecture, landing zones, standards and governance.

Set technical direction across enterprise networking, connectivity and core infrastructure services.

Oversee identity and endpoint management, Windows and Linux environments, backup and recovery.

Strengthen cloud security and operational resilience, including disaster recovery, patching and vulnerability remediation.

Drive FinOps and cloud cost optimization, improving transparency around consumption, budgets and infrastructure investments.

Manage infrastructure suppliers and managed service providers, ensuring clear responsibilities, measurable service levels and reliable delivery.

The role has a broad international scope, with close collaboration across OX2's technology organization, business stakeholders and external partners
YOU ARE 
You have a solid background in cloud and infrastructure and experience taking responsibility for complex technical environments. You understand how architecture, networking, security and operations fit together. You bring strong experience from Azure or AWS, or both, and a good understanding of enterprise networking and infrastructure architecture. You are familiar with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, and have experience with several of the services surrounding cloud infrastructure, such as Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Windows or Linux environments, and backup and recovery.
You have worked closely with external suppliers or managed service providers and know how to set requirements, evaluate technical solutions and follow up on delivery. You also understand the financial side of infrastructure and have experience improving operational efficiency and managing cloud costs. You are comfortable making decisions and challenging established ways of working when needed. With a practical approach, you can move between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior management, explaining not only what needs to be done but also why it matters to the business. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from the energy sector, critical infrastructure or another regulated environment is valuable, but not required.
At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence the infrastructure supporting an international renewable energy business. With broad responsibility and considerable autonomy, you will help shape the technical foundation for OX2's operations and continued development within data, AI and digital services
WANT TO KNOW MORE?
For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We are looking forward hearing from you!
ABOUT OX2
OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage. 
With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.

jobs.occupation: Senior Lithography & Process Development Engineer to Mycronic
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
For over 50 years, our innovative solutions have developed and manufactured machines for electronics and display manufacturing. We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing. 
In this role, you will be part of our R&D team Metrology and Process Control Group (PMCD), which currently consists of 12 team members working within pattern design, metrology, cleanliness, and data analysis.
Work tasks
Technical Project Leadership
Lead technically demanding customer demonstrations and development activities from concept to implementation.
Coordinate cross-functional activities with production, quality, metrology, R&D, suppliers, and customers.
Drive technical decisions, manage priorities and risks, and ensure successful delivery.
Mentor colleagues and contribute to the development of engineering competence within PMCD.

Lithography Process Ownership
Own and continuously improve lithography processes to ensure process capability, stability, yield, and product quality.
Define and maintain process specifications, operating procedures, and engineering standards.
Lead root-cause investigations and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Advanced Process Control (APC)
Develop and implement APC strategies using statistical methods, SPC, DOE, and other data-driven approaches.
Analyze process and metrology data to identify sources of variation and define opportunities for improvement.
Define and monitor relevant process KPIs and drive improvements in process robustness and performance.

Process Development & Technology Innovation
Lead the development and qualification of new lithography processes, materials, and equipment.
Design and execute experiments to optimize processes and support technology development.
Translate research and emerging technologies into robust, scalable manufacturing solutions.

We are looking for
This is a role for you who enjoy combining scientific understanding with practical engineering to develop robust, data-driven solutions that create long-term value. You have a structured and analytical mindset and thrive in multidisciplinary environments. You are curious, proactive, and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, technologies, and ways of working. As you will collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, customers, and stakeholders across the organization, you are a strong team player who enjoys building relationships, fostering collaboration, and leading technical discussions to achieve common goals.
On top of that, you have:
A Masters Degree or Ph.D. in Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Electronics, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
At least some years of industrial experience in semiconductor manufacturing, lithography, photomask manufacturing, or another advanced manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of process engineering, process characterization, and statistical data analysis.
Experience with DOE, root-cause analysis, and systematic problem-solving methodologies.
Experience leading technical projects or coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities.
Strong knowledge in English, both written and spoken.

We see it as a merit if you have:
Experience with APC, SPC, process monitoring, and metrology systems.
Experience qualifying new processes, materials, or equipment.
Knowledge of semiconductor, photomask, or display manufacturing technologies.
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, or other structured continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience working with international customers and suppliers.

Additional information
Start: By agreement 
Scope: Full-time 
Location: Täby and possibility of hybrid work (but minimum 3 days per week In office as an average)
